description: A Java Swing UI panel class for configuring server connection options such as host, port, user, password, and trust store path, used within a JMeter plugin for Eclipse Hono.

classes.name: ServerOptionsPanel
classes.description: A Swing panel derived from VerticalPanel for configuring server connection details in a JMeter plugin.

methods.name: ServerOptionsPanel
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the panel UI with a given title and sets up the border and UI components.

methods.name: getHost
methods.description: Returns the text entered in the Host field.

methods.name: getPort
methods.description: Returns the text entered in the Port field.

methods.name: getUser
methods.description: Returns the text entered in the User field.

methods.name: getPwd
methods.description: Returns the text entered in the Password field.

methods.name: getTrustStorePath
methods.description: Returns the text entered in the Truststore Path field.

methods.name: setTrustStorePath
methods.description: Sets the Truststore Path field text.

methods.name: clearGui
methods.description: Clears all input fields in the GUI.
